3824331.sourceDescription: Short on floor space but not on festive spirit? This 6ft pencil tree is made for smaller rooms where every inch counts. It's slim, compact and fits neatly into corners without taking over. You're getting a full-height tree with hinged branches that slot together in minutes - no fiddling about with complicated builds. Just connect the two pieces into the metal stand, fluff out the 297 tips so they look full and natural, then get decorating. Being artificial means no dropped needles to hoover up and no mess to clear away. It's made from PVC with flat needles that stay put, and because it's fire retardant, you can use lights safely (around 480 works perfectly for this size). Pack it away after the holidays and bring it back out next year - it's built to last season after season. .
